data.name: Ayyub
data.gender_notes: Ayyub is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Iyyov (Job); the etymology is uncertain, often linked to 'persecuted' or 'repentant'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-y-w-b. The prophet Ayyūb (Job), known for his patience. Ayyub is a Arabic name meaning “Persecuted; repentant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ayyub expresses “Persecuted; repentant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Iyyov (Job); the etymology is uncertain, often linked to 'persecuted' or 'repentant'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayyub total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
